name: will-plugins
description: Personal plugins for Chip's will agent ecosystem — reflect, commit-push, ingest, and subject-repo tools

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: End-of-session reflection skill. Summarizes the session and writes a dated reflection file to the will repo.

plugins.name: ingest
plugins.description: Cross-repo source ingest — PDFs, DOCX, VTT, HTML, URLs, and YouTube transcripts into <repo>/research/refs/ as versioned markdown. Used by health, money, home.

plugins.name: commit-push
plugins.description: Skill that wraps the commit_push.py tool — replaces the git add/commit/push chain with one pre-approved CLI call.
